Breakfast Sausage Bake
• 12 eggs
• 1 cup heavy cream
• 1 package of shredded cheddar cheese
• 1 pound of breakfast sausage
• Salsa (I use 1 of the
small jars)

1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Brown the sausage and drain the
fat
3. Whisk the eggs and cream, stir in the
sausage and cheese, and bake for 40
minutes until set.
4. Top with salsa and serve!
